messages:
kevin: Heads-up: scheduling a small maintenance for Vault auth + KMS-backed audit encryption in staging tomorrow. Plan: switch pod auth to GKE/IAM-bound flow, enable audithook writing KMS-wrapped blobs to the consumer. Window: 2026-05-14 01:30 UTC (canary) -> 02:30 UTC full. Need RBAC review, KMS IAM grant, and confirm owners for rotating long-lived tokens before cutover.

anita: I can do RBAC review & merge. Please post the exact ClusterRole/RoleBinding diff and list of affected svcaccounts. Scope canary to `staging-workers` namespace only.

sam: Quick diffs pasted here — tighten secrets perms and add a dedicated `vault-audit-writer` SA:
```diff
- resources: ["secrets"]
- verbs: ["*"]
+ resources: ["secrets"]
+ verbs: ["get","list"]
```
svcaccounts: `vault-audit-writer` (infra), `staging-ingest` SAs, `ci-runner-staging`.

maria: I'll own KMS binding. Will create `serviceAccount:vault-audit@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` with `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on key `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/audit-wrap-2026`. I will not rotate the wrapping key during cutover.

ops-bot: SYSTEM: Maintenance window created: 2026-05-14 01:30-02:30 UTC. Stakeholders: @anita @maria.

kevin: Checklist:
- By EOD today: publish long-lived token owners list.
- Maria: add KMS IAM binding + run encrypt/decrypt test in staging.
- Anita: merge RBAC PR.
- Canary 01:30 UTC (20m): enable IAM auth for `staging-workers` and enable audithook for that namespace only. Monitor auth failures + KMS decrypt errors.
- Full 02:30 UTC: roll cluster-wide if canary OK.
- Post-cutover 24h: rotate any long-lived tokens and schedule key rewrap after 48h if stable.

anita: Detection query (ELK) for auth failures: `index=audit-vault-* AND json.event_type:auth AND json.status:401 | stats count() by json.client_name`. If >3% for 5m we rollback.

maria: KMS note: I'll add a staging test that writes a wrapped blob and the consumer decrypts. Also will annotate the key with `cutover=2026-05-14` to track.

kevin: If rollback needed, revert `auth/kubernetes` enablement and re-enable token engine using the revert manifest in the runbook. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/infrastructure/runbooks/vault-kms-auth-cutover. Ping me if you need escalation. :thumbsup:
